title: 扩散语言模型中的自生成错误训练用于令牌编辑
summary: 针对LLaDA2.1扩散语言模型中令牌编辑的训练-推理不匹配问题，提出自生成T2T方法：通过无梯度草稿传递生成自生成错误，并监督恢复过程。在LLaDA2.1-mini上使用LoRA持续预训练实现，在多个基准测试中提升了准确性，同时减少了编辑强度，缓解了最终数字转录错误和过度自我修正等失败模式。
summary_en: Addresses the training-inference mismatch in token-to-token editing for LLaDA2.1 diffusion language models by proposing self-generated T2T, which uses a no-gradient draft pass to create self-generated corruptions and supervises recovery. Implemented via LoRA continued-pretraining on LLaDA2.1-mini, it improves accuracy and reduces edit intensity on benchmarks, mitigating failures like final-digit transcription errors and excessive self-correction.
